query: What review signals predict negative IMDb audience satisfaction?

per_column.name: script_quality_verdict
per_column.rationale: A distinct aspect axis (writing/script) that can be grouped against label_pos to see if script complaints predict negativity. Values match text: IMDB-0001 explicitly calls writing insipid (poor), IMDB-0004 silent on script (null) is correct. Well grounded.

per_column.name: acting_quality_verdict
per_column.rationale: Separate performance axis, useful for modeling. IMDB-0003 'performances are wooden' -> poor is sound; IMDB-0004 'acting is pretty good' -> good is exact. But IMDB-0002 has no clear acting comment yet produced 'poor', a mild over-assertion. Nulls for silent rows appropriate.

per_column.name: production_quality_verdict
per_column.rationale: Useful production-craft axis. However near-absence of nulls (only 1) is suspicious given many reviews say nothing on production. IMDB-0005 has no production comment yet got 'mixed', and IMDB-0002 got 'poor' without specific production evidence — signs of forced non-null inference beyond source support.

per_column.name: plot_coherence
per_column.rationale: Coherence/predictability is a genuine analytical axis distinct from tone. IMDB-0003 'predictable premise' -> predictable is well grounded; silent rows (0001,0002,0004) correctly null. Sound.

per_column.name: reviewer_emotional_tone
per_column.rationale: Well-grounded and graded (strong/mild) so richer than a bare sentiment flag, but it is largely a restatement of the existing label_pos target, offering limited new leverage for predicting satisfaction. Values track text accurately.

per_column.name: comparative_benchmark
per_column.rationale: Whether a review benchmarks against other films is a genuine, non-obvious signal. IMDB-0001 compares to Star Trek Voyager (negative_comparison) is correct; silent rows -> no_comparison is right. Grounded.

per_column.name: rec_signal
per_column.rationale: Recommend/avoid signal is analytically strong for predicting satisfaction. IMDB-0004 'A must see' -> explicit_recommend is exact; IMDB-0001/0002 -> explicit_avoid reasonable though somewhat inferred rather than explicit imperative. Mostly sound.

judge.rationale: The added columns decompose reviews into distinct, analytically valuable aspect axes (script, acting, production, plot, tone, comparison, recommendation) that give real grouping/modeling leverage for predicting negative satisfaction. Most values are sound readings of the source text, with appropriate nulls for silent rows. Main weaknesses: reviewer_emotional_tone largely restates the existing label target, and production_quality_verdict shows forced non-null inference (nearly no nulls, values assigned where the text is silent), the clearest groundedness concern.
